question: Should Birdclaw make merge-safe archive and backup imports the default for existing users, requiring explicit `--restore` for exact replacement?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and documented, but it deliberately changes the behavior of existing import workflows and introduces a durable schema contract; only the repository owner can choose that product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Adopt merge-safe imports
options.body: Accept destination-row preservation as the new default and retain `--restore` plus deprecated `--replace` as the explicit exact-replacement route.

options.title: Preserve replay-by-default
options.body: Keep current exact-replay semantics as the default and make merge-safe behavior an explicit new option instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt merge-safe imports
recommendation.body: Accept destination-row preservation as the new default and retain `--restore` plus deprecated `--replace` as the explicit exact-replacement route.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the contract and the successive implementation revisions across the affected storage surfaces.
